Look at `src/app/page.tsx` for the pattern — it imports Nav and Footer directly.

**No `any`. Strict TypeScript. Each `<a href>` for CTAs (no buttons).**

## Page structure

```
<Nav />
<main>
  1. HeroSection (variant="centered", dark)
  2. <PricingTiersSection /> — 4-tier grid lifted from homepage
  3. <CompareSection /> — Comparison table vs DaySmart, Mangomint, Fresha, TattooGenda
  4. <ROISection /> — Stat strip + savings calc copy
  5. <FAQAccordion> — 8 pricing-specific questions
  6. <CTASection> — closing
</main>
<Footer />
```

```tsx
  variant="dark"
```

**Section 2 — Pricing tiers (4-tier grid, lift exact pattern from `src/components/home/pricing.tsx`):**

Section paddingTop 0 (since hero ends in dark), paddingBottom 100. Use `id="tiers"`.

**Section 4 — ROI section:**

GRADIENT.sectionWarm background. paddingTop 100, paddingBottom 100. Center container maxWidth 1120.

```tsx
<StatStrip items={[
  { stat: '12 hr / wk', label: 'time recovered, average' },
  { stat: '$2,400 / mo', label: 'recovered at $50 / hr studio rate' },
  { stat: '$59 / mo', label: 'InkOS Studio plan' },
  { stat: '40×', label: 'return in month one' },
]} />
```

Below stat strip: a centered serif quote in italic stoneDark, max-width 640: "On average, studios moving from a salon-coded SaaS recover the InkOS subscription cost 40 times over in their first month — purely from time saved on app-switching."

**Section 5 — FAQ:**

GRADIENT.sectionCool background. SectionEyebrow "Common questions" accent="sage". Heading "Pricing, plain and direct." size sm. paddingTop 100 paddingBottom 100.

```tsx
const faqs = [
  { q: "Is there really no card required to start?", a: "Correct. Sign up, work for 14 days, and only enter card details if you decide to keep going. We don't auto-charge at the end of the trial." },
  { q: "What happens if I downgrade mid-cycle?", a: "Your current cycle continues at the higher tier until renewal. The new plan kicks in next billing cycle. No proration math needed — and no penalty for switching." },
  { q: "Do you charge a transaction fee on bookings or deposits?", a: "Never. You pay the monthly software fee. Stripe takes its standard processing fee on cards (2.9% + 30¢ in the US). InkOS takes nothing on top." },
  { q: "What about overages — SMS sends, AI design generations?", a: "SMS and AI design are metered. Each plan includes a generous monthly allotment. Overages are at-cost, billed monthly. No 'unlimited' games — you only pay for what you use." },
  { q: "Can I add team seats mid-month?", a: "Yes. Studio plan includes 5 active artists. Pro is unlimited. Add or remove artists any time — billing prorates automatically." },
  { q: "Do you support currencies outside USD?", a: "Yes. We bill in USD, but Stripe collects from your clients in their local currency. Studios in 47 countries are running on InkOS today." },
  { q: "How are taxes handled?", a: "Stripe Tax is enabled on every plan. Sales tax / VAT on your subscription is calculated based on your studio address. Your client invoices use your own tax settings." },
  { q: "Is there a longer free trial for Enterprise?", a: "Yes. Multi-location chains get a 30-day pilot at one location, fully migrated, before you commit to the rest of the rollout." },
];

<FAQAccordion items={faqs} accent="sage" />
```

Wrap accordion in maxWidth 920, margin auto.

**Section 6 — Closing CTA:**

```tsx
<CTASection
  badge="The decision takes one minute"
  headline="Pick a plan and start the trial."
  italicWord="trial"
  subhead="14-day free trial on every plan. No card required. White-glove migration included above Solo. Cancel without a phone call."
  primaryCTA={{ label: "Start a 14-day trial", href: "https://inkos.up.railway.app/signup" }}
  secondaryCTA={{ label: "Book a 30-min walkthrough", href: "/book-a-demo", icon: "play" }}
/>
```

- Wrap the whole thing in a div with `style={{ minHeight: '100vh', background: BRAND.bone, overflow: 'hidden' }}`.

- Each section is a `<section>` with proper background and padding.
- Use `motion` + `whileInView` for section reveals where appropriate (don't overdo it).
- All copy should match the brand voice — confident, specific, anti-SaaS-template.
